text: # Data Retention Policy Customer transaction records are retained for 7 years to satisfy financial audit requirements, after which they are securely deleted. Application logs are kept for 90 days in hot storage and archived for 1 year in cold storage. Backups are encrypted with AES-256 and retained for 35 days. Employee records are retained for 6 years after termination. Data subject deletion requests under GDPR must be fulfilled within 30 days, unless legal hold applies. The Data Protection Officer approves any exception to these retention periods.

# Travel and Expense Reimbursement Employees may claim reasonable business expenses within 30 days of the expense date through the Expense app. Receipts are required for any item above 25 USD. Domestic hotel stays are capped at 220 USD per night and international stays at 300 USD per night. Meals are reimbursed up to 70 USD per day while traveling. Flights over 6 hours may be booked in premium economy with director approval. Alcohol is not reimbursable. Claims above 2,000 USD require additional approval from the department head, and reimbursements are paid in the next monthly payroll cycle.

# Leave Policy Full-time employees accrue 1.75 days of paid annual leave per month, for a total of 21 days per year. Unused leave up to 10 days may be carried over into the next calendar year; any balance above 10 days expires on March 31. Sick leave is separate and grants 12 paid days per year, with a medical certificate required for absences longer than 3 consecutive days. Parental leave is 16 weeks for the primary caregiver and 4 weeks for the secondary caregiver. Leave requests must be submitted through the HR portal at least 5 working days in advance, except for emergencies, and approved by the line manager.

# Security Incident Response Runbook Severity SEV-1 incidents include confirmed data exfiltration, ransomware, or compromise of production credentials. For a SEV-1, the on-call engineer must page the Incident Commander within 15 minutes and open a dedicated war-room channel. Containment steps: revoke exposed API keys, rotate secrets in the vault, isolate affected hosts using the EDR console, and snapshot disks for forensics. Customers must be notified within 72 hours of confirmed personal data breach, in line with GDPR Article 33. A blameless post-incident review must be published within 5 business days. SEV-2 incidents involve partial service degradation without data loss and require acknowledgement within 1 hour.

# Remote Access and VPN Guide Employees working remotely must connect through the corporate VPN using the WireGuard client. Multi-factor authentication via a hardware security key (FIDO2) is mandatory for all VPN sessions. Split tunneling is disabled; all traffic is routed through the corporate gateway at vpn.example-corp.net on UDP port 51820. Sessions time out after 12 hours of inactivity and devices must have full-disk encryption and an up-to-date endpoint agent. If the VPN fails to connect, verify that UDP 51820 is not blocked by the local network, then contact the IT service desk at extension 4400.
